attempted_contrary_interfaces: First-tier diversity treated as independent lower-tier supply.
A complete document treated as operational capability.
A partial exposure or criterion input rejected for failing the whole receiver.
Capacity, stock or staff double-counted for routine and contingency use.
Buyer savings treated as joint fair gain.

positive_controls.argument: The owned semantic and configuration boundary identifies which substitutions preserve the required behavior and what changed dependency needs notification.
The decision horizon and separability of the intended increment identify which hidden dependencies and substitute qualifications matter.
Scenario ranges and sensitivity to lead time identify which opaque dependency is consequential enough to investigate and maintain.
Real data rights, ownership, lead times and change duties determine how dependency information may be obtained and which alternative can be qualified.
The operational system, cutover horizon and support requirements define the criticality and timeliness needed of dependency information.
Current recovery tests and time/state objectives distinguish merely known alternatives from usable ones and specify which portability must be demonstrated.
Fielded configuration, support horizon and retirement authority determine which lower-tier data and substitute readiness are worth maintaining.
The actual consequence, commitment deadline and permitted cheap path determine which dependencies need deep mapping and what substitute evidence is adequate.
